outcome: Deliver one bounded job from authorized inputs to a useful independently readable result without broad host access; preserve the blocked Phase 0 gate and qualify ordinary MCP and persistent Locus separately.

roles.description: Own the BunBox value, scope, user decisions, and handoff
roles.prompt: Read docs/ORIGIN.md (BB-ORIGIN-001), docs/task-list.md and active canonical KBD context. Keep authoring and acceptance separate. Preserve current blocked Phase 0 and report exact prerequisites. Do not authorize execution, integrations, or release.
inputs: Reviewed Origin and exact adopted scope

roles.description: Own isolated worker, supervisor, and VM lifecycle
roles.prompt: Use docs/execution-contract.md, docs/transport-decision.md and docs/threat-model.md. Design or implement only within a separately adopted scope; existing preflight/framing is intentional. Refuse host fallback or unqualified runtime. Keep creation reconciliation, cancellation and independently verified teardown distinct.
inputs: Reviewed Origin and exact adopted scope

roles.description: Own bounded general-agent MCP tool and transport compatibility
roles.prompt: Use docs/mcp-tool-server.md and docs/compatibility.md. Separate stdio, Streamable HTTP and expressly qualified legacy HTTP+SSE. Keep bounded parsing, grant checks, intent and response reconciliation consistent without lower-authority fallbacks.
inputs: Reviewed Origin and exact adopted scope

roles.description: Own persistent Locus and ordinary harness integration contract
roles.prompt: Use docs/locus-external-tool.md and docs/ORIGIN.md. Preserve independently useful local and general agent tools; hosted and persistent Locus integration is optional later work. Trace cross-device resume to current scope, exact job identity, and independently readable durable result. Never infer authority from a tool call or memory.
inputs: Reviewed Origin and exact adopted scope

roles.description: Independently review user outcome, authority, and phase-end evidence
roles.prompt: Use the exact candidate, acceptance criteria and independent artifact/behavior evidence. Challenge whether material user value is proven, receipts are truthful, grants are current, unauthorized effects are absent, and earlier VM/transport gates remain in force. Do not invoke external models unless separately authorized, execute product or repair the author’s work as reviewer.
inputs: Reviewed Origin and exact adopted scope
outputs: Independent read-only findings and exact limits
